tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po lam zab mthar thug zhang gi

man ngag bzhugs so/ / bla ma rje btsun dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi/ /thugs rje'i phrin las mchog gyur dbang bskur ba'i/ / zhags pa mtha' yas don yod cig gyur pa'i/ /rtogs ldan bla ma'i tshogs la gus btud nas/ /sde snod rgyud sde theg mchog mtha' dag gi /bcud kyi yang snying bde gshegs kun gyi thugs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug thugs nas thugs su brgyud/ /zur mtshon tsam zhig skyon bral spro bas dgod/ /gzhan phan sbyangs stobs bdag la med mod kyi/ /dam chos rjes 'brangs gus pa'i blo gros can/ /slob mas rab bskul brtson 'grus grags pa yis/ /gal te phan par srid mtha' mi khegs snyam/ /rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus bskyed pa'i yum/ / sngon sbyangs skal ldan rnams kyis rtogs bya ba/ /rje btsun brgyud ldan rnams kyi thugs kyi mdzod/ /lung rigs man ngag ma lus theg pa'i bcud/ / nges don mthar thug snying po chos kyi sku/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rnam dag 'od gsal dbyings/ / dus gsum rgyal ba byon rung ma byon rung*/ /'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rtogs rung ma rtogs rung*/ /thub pa rnams kyis gsungs rung ma gsungs rung*/ / dgongs 'grel mkhan pos bkrol rung ma bkrol rung*/ /chos nyid 'od gsal spros bral rnam dag 'di/ /ye nas lhun grub 'phel 'grib med par gnas/ / nam mkha' dag la 'jig rten chags 'jig gis/ /me yis bsreg dang rlung gis gtor la sogs/ /bskal ba dpag med mang por gnod bskyal yang*/ / mkha' la ma gnod 'gyur med 'phel 'grib med/ /nyi 'od ye gsal sprin gyis rab bsgribs pas/ /mun par 'thibs dang sprin tshogs sangs pa'i tshe/ / gsal bar gyur pa'i 'phel 'grib ltar snang gi /nyi ma'i snying po 'phel dang 'grib mi srid/ /de ltar gnas pa'i 'gyur med chos sku 'di/ /rang gi sems las ma gtogs gzhan na med/ /sna tshogs 'khor 'das ma lus sems la shar/

/rang sems ma rtogs phyin log 'khrul dbang gis/ /dkrugs pas 'khor ba'i snod bcud sdug bsngal shar/ /rang sems nges rtogs mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /ye shes mtha' yas bde ba chen por shar/ /de phyir ma lus rang gi sems nyid las/ /'phros phyir rang sems chos nyid ngo shes na/ /sems can kun gyi chos nyid shes par 'gyur/ /de shes mya ngan 'das sogs chos kun shes/ /chos kun yongs shes khams gsum kun las 'das/ /gcig shes pas ni kun la mkhas par 'gyur/ /rtsa ba 'gyel bas lo 'dab ngang gis 'gyel/ /de phyir rang sems gcig pu gtan la dbab/ /kun gyi sa bon rang sems gnas lugs ni/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi thugs dang ni/ /ye nas khyad med skye med chos skur mnyam/ /bem po ma yin rang rig ngang gis gsal/ /dngos po ma grub mdog dbyibs tshad kyis stong*/ /dngos med ma yin rkyen gyis cir yang gsal/ /rtag par mi 'gyur ngo bo nyid kyis stong*/ /chad par mi 'gyur rang gsal ngo bo nyid/ /bdag tu ma grub brtags na snying po med/ /bdag med ma yin spros bral bdag nyid che/ /mtha' rnams ma grub 'dzin pa gang yang med/ /dbu ma ma grub ltos pa kun las dben/ /dpe yis mi mtshon mtshon cha'i ngos bzung med/ /dpe med ma yin nam mkha' lta bu'o/ / tshig tu ma grub brjod pas snyad du med/ /tshig bral ma yin brjod pa kun gyi rgyu/ /yod dang med dang bden dang brdzun pa dang*/ /stong dang mi stong zhi dang ma zhi dang*/ /spros pa yod dang spros pa med pa dang*/ /bsam du yod dang bsam gyis mi khyab dang*/ /bde dang sdug bsngal dmigs su yod med dang*/ /gnyis med gnyis med blo las 'das ma 'das/ /bden dang mi bden grub dang ma grub dang*/ /dag dang ma dag lhun gyis grub ma grub/ /de 'dra'i tshig tshogs brjod pas thug pa med/ /ji tsam zab cing rno ba'i tshig tshogs kyis/ /rnam grangs du mar brjod par byas gyur kyang*/

/sems kyi gnas lugs thog tu phebs mi srid/ /ji tsam mkhas shing zab pa'i brtag dpyad kyis/ /bskal ba mang por brtags shing dpyad byas kyang*/ /rang bzhin gnyug ma btags pa'i yul min phyir/ /sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa mi srid do/ /dper na rgya mtshor shar ba'i gza' skar de/ /dar tshags ji tsam zhib pas btsags byas kyang*/ /gza' skar dngos po dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ /gza' skar gcig kyang zin pa mi srid do/ /ji srid tshig tu brjod nus de srid du/ /ming 'dogs ji tsam legs kyang gnas lugs min/ /ji tsam yid kyis dpyad bzod de srid du/ /ji tsam zab par rtogs kyang gnas lugs min/ /blta bya lta byed gnyis 'dzin de srid du/ /gnyis su med pa'i gnas lugs rtogs mi srid/ /mdor na yin snyam mtha' dag zhen pa'i rtsa/ /zhen pa'i rtsa bas 'khor ba mtha' dag spel/ /stong pa nyid yin snyam du 'du shes dang*/ /mtshan ma med snyam smon pa med snyam dang*/ / ngos bzung med snyam rnam par dag snyam dang*/ /skye ba med snyam dmigs su med snyam dang*/ /rang bzhin med snyam spros las dben snyam dang*/ /ngag dang yid kyi spyod yul min snyam dang*/ /ma byas lhun gyis grub snyam la sogs pa'i/ /ji tsam zab cing stong par 'du shes kyang*/ /rlom sems mtshan ma dag las ma g.yos pas/ /mtshan ma'i zhen pas phyir zhing dman par ltung*/ /dman pa'i las kyis rnam smin rgyun mi chad/ khong gcong mi phyin phyir zhing nad rab ldang*/ /blos byas lta ba mkhan gyi sgom chen rnams/ /phyogs 'dzin zhen pa'i nad gcong zhugs par mchi'o/ / mnyam bral lhan cig skyes par mkhyen par mdzod/ /drang ba'i don du sgro btags tsam du zad/ /gnas lugs nges don 'di yin zhes bya ba/ / thub pas kyang ni gzigs pa yod mi srid/ kho bos smras pa des kyang mi dpog ste/ /mdzub mos zla ba mtshon pa bzhin du rtogs/ /de ltar shes na tha snyad tshig tshogs kyis/

/sgrib par mi 'gyur tshig gi skyon mi gos/ /de phyir tshig dang brtag dpyad mi spang zhing*/ /don du rlom pas zhen par yang mi bya/ /de lta bu yi rang sems chos sku de/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog phung po khams dang ni/ /skye mched la sogs sems can mkha' mnyam dang*/ /sa rdo nags tshal rtsi shing snod bcud khyab/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /bde gshegs rgya mtsho ma lus kun la khyab/ /mdor na phyi nang dngos po la sogs la/ /ma lus lus pa med la kun tu khyab/ khyab kyang khyab bya khyab byed gnyis su med/ /bdag nyid chen po gcig gi cho 'phrul yin/ /rgya mtshor shar ba'i gza' skar thams cad la/ /rgya mtshos khyab kyis gnyis su dbyer mi phyed/ /chu nyid 'khyoms pa'i rba rlabs thams cad la/ /chu yis khyab mod rba rlabs ji ltar phyod/ /bar snang dag la smig sgyu g.yo ba la/ /bar snang dag gis khyab kyis dbyer mi phyed/ /gser las byas pa'i rgyan ni sna tshogs la/ /gser gyis khyab mod ji ltar dbye rgyu phyaid// bu ram las byas rigs drug gzugs brnyan la/ /bu ram dag gis khyab ste dbyer mi phyed/ /'ja' tshon dag las nam mkha' gzhan ma yin/ /nam mkha' las kyang 'ja' tshon gzhan ma yin/ /'ja' tshon nam mkha'o mkha' nyid 'ja' tshon no/ /tha dad ma yin dbyer med spyad du med/ /de bzhin sems dang sna tshogs dbyer mi phyed/ /sems dang stong par mi phyed stong pa dang*/ /bde ba chen por mi phyed mnyam pa nyid/ /de srid srid dang myang 'das dbyer mi phyed/ /de ltar byas pa'i sems nyid phyag rgya che/ /rang bzhin stong la cir yang ngos bzung med/ /mtshan nyid rig pa cho 'phrul cir yang gsal/ /ngo bo dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje sems/ /yon tan dpag med 'byung gnas rin chen sems/ /zad med blag med stor med sus kyang ni/ /'phrog par mi nus nam mkha' mdzod kyi sems/ /dri mas ma gos shel sgong dag pa'i sems/

/rang rig rang gsal mar me lta bu'i sems/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal byang chub snying po'i sems/ / rgyun chad med pa chu bo lta bu'i sems/ /ngos bzung med pa bar snang lta bu'i sems/ /phyi med nang med ye shes zang thal sems/ /'khar gzhong gtsang ma chu yis gang ba 'dra/ /bag chags gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'char ba'i sems/ / me long g.ya' med phyis pa'i ngos dang 'dra/ /lta ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// // de ltar gnas pa'i rang sems gnyug ma de/ /mi rtogs log par rtog pa'i rkyen dbang gis/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i sgro btags nas/ / phyin ci log zhen mthu yis nyon mongs dang*/ /rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs rnams rab tu 'phel/ /de yis las bsags las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /'khor ba'i chu bo mi zad rba klong du/ /skye 'chi la sogs sdug bsngal mi zad pas/ /g.yengs shing g.yengs shing rgyun chad med par mnar/ /'gro ba rigs drug snang ba sna tshogs la/ /log par mthong ba'i bag chags sna tshogs kyis/ /sems la tshang bcas rnam par rtog pa spel/ /phyin ci log gi spyod ngan sna tshogs kyis/ / bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas/ /rgyun chad med pa yang dang yang du myong*/ /myong ba nyid kyis gti mug phyi phyir 'phel/ /mgo yus kyis brgyal bas khong khro dang*/ /nga rgyal zhe 'dod ser sna la sogs pas/ /rang sems yang nas yang du dkrug par byed/ /kye ma 'khor ba 'di la su yid rton/ / rang sems gnyug ma'i gnas lugs rtogs gyur na/ /log par rtog pa'i mun nag sangs par 'gyur/ / bdag 'dzin nyon mongs zhen pa las grol na/ /las dang sdug bsngal kun las nges par thar/ /ye nas gnas pa'i chos sku mngon du gyur/ /smon lam 'phen pas gzhan don 'bad med 'grub/ /rgyu bde lam bde 'bras bu'i dus su bde// mya ngan 'das pa'i rten 'brel dang re spro/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu sdug bsngal ba'i/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhe re 'jigs/

/de bas 'khor ba'i 'dam nas bros nas ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i skam sar cis mi bsnyegs/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i chos la gang spro de/ /thog mar chos la zhugs ma thag nas kyang*/ /dad pas dge ba'i phyogs su blo song bas/ / bzhin mdog ngan kyang kun gyi yid 'ongs na/ /bzhin ldan chos la zhugs rnams smos ci dgos/ /snyan grags spangs kyang kun gyis snyan pa sgrog /bkur sti spangs kyang kun gyis bkur bar byed/ /dman sa bzung yang kun gyis gong du 'khur// sdug bsngal bsgrubs kyang mi tshe skyid la skyel/ /dbul por gyur kyang longs spyod yo lang byed/ /lto gos 'bad pa med pa zhar la 'byung*/ / gcig pur bros kyang 'khor slob tshogs dang 'phrad/ /bskrad pa med kyang log 'dren bgegs rnams bros/ /bos pa med kyang lha dang chos skyong du/ /chags sdang nga rgyal sogs kyis kun bslangs nas/ khram zol g.yo sgyu gtso bor spyad byas kyang*/ /thos pa la sogs dge spyad dam dum kun/ /chud mi za bar yon tan tshod ka la/ /longs spyod byed pa rnams la mngon sum gzigs/ /nga rgyal la sogs nyon mongs mnyam pa la/ /thos pa bag tsam byas te mi chen byed/ /dge ba'i gzugs brnyan dam dum spyod pa yis/ /yon tan dam dum kun yang mi bslus na/ /dam chos gsha' mar spyod rnams smos ci dgos/ /zhugs ma thag gi yon tan de 'dra na/ /sgrub la brtson pa'i yon tan ji tsam zhig /bdag po med pa'i ri brag lung stong na/ /tshul 'chos min pa'i spyod pa bag re yangs/ / mi drin med pa'i skyid shas a re mnog /'phya zlos med pa'i ri dwags 'grogs re bde/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma'i bzang gos dro la mdzes/ /ma chags chog shes nor rdzas zad pa med/ /bzod pa'i go cha mthug cing sra la yang*/ /shugs kyis mgyogs pa'i brtson 'grus rta re bzang*/ /phyin chad bla ma dkon mchog skyabs re bzang*// thabs lam gnad kyi nyams myong nyams re dga'/

/bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin zhe re zhim/ /rang rig dri med stong pa 'od re gsal/ /gzhi med ci yang snang ba rgod re bro/ /gang shar dbyings las ma g.yos blo re bde/ /nyams myong bdud rtsis tshims pas kha re ngoms/ /spros bral nang nas shar bas sems re gtsang*/ /rtog pa'i rang bzhin shes pas thag re chod/ / rig pa'i mdzod la dbang byed zhe re phyug /snang grags chos skur longs spyod a re skyid/ /snang grags kha lo bsgyur bas dbang re che/ /log rtog bdud dmag thul bas kha re drag /'khor ba'i dong nas thon pas pho re shor/ /'gro don shugs kyis 'grub pas phan re che/ /bde chen thang la rgyug pas bang re mgyogs/ /de sogs sgrub la brtson pa'i yon tan tshogs/ /bskal bar brjod kyang zad med brjod mi lang*/ /sgrub la brtson pa'i yon tan de 'dra na/ /drod rtags thob pa'i yon tan smos ci dgos/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon shes la sogs pa'i/ /yon tan bskal bar brjod kyang thug pa med/ /drod rtags thob pa'i yon tan de 'dra na// sku gsum mngon gyur yon tan smos ci dgos/ /bla med ye shes bsam yas la sogs pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan brjod pas zad mi srid/ /'khor 'das sa mtshams shan dbye ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // ji tsam tshig la rno zhing dpyod mkhas kyang*/ /nyams su ma blangs nang nas ma shar bar/ /blo yis brtags pas gnas lugs rtogs mi srid/ / gnas lugs ma rtogs bag chags byang mi srid/ /de phyir tshig dang rtog ge'i shes rab la/ /ma zhen bla ma'i man ngag nyams su longs/ /ne tso'i 'don pa dpag shi'i glur song na/ /bdag gzhan ma mthong g.yang la lhung nyen gda'o/ / dam pa'i gdams ngag nyams su len pa'i sems/ /lus dang srog la ma chags bya ba thong*/ /ltogs 'khyags na'am mu ges shi yang sla'i/ /thams cad rmi lam yin gyis bor la thong*/ /kun gyis brnyas dang grags ngan phog kyang rung*/ /

dman sa zung la sgrub pa snying por 'bungs/ /'jig rten bya ba ma thengs sdig pa'i rgyu/ /'khyags drir ltogs drir shi yis dogs pas lan/ /sprang ban zhang gi yon tan bag tsam 'di/ /lus srog 'ben du btsugs pa'i bka' drin lags/ / nor rdzas khab skud man chod spangs gyur kyang*/ /'tsho ba'i sems khral byed nas spangs pa min/ /ngan mi 'dod kyi bsam pa ma spangs na/ /'jig rten bya ba thongs pa'i dus mi mchi/ /'jig rten mtha' dag blo yis ma btang na/ /ci byas ngal ba don med sdig pa'i rgyu/ /'jig rten mtha' dag blo yis ma thongs na/ / gtong phod byas dang tshul khrims bsrungs pa dang*/ /bla ma mchod dang dben pa brten pa dang*/ /bsam gtan 'bad dang nyams myong bzang snyam dang*/ /shes rab che dang rtogs pa mtho la sogs/ /dge sbyor ci byas ngal ba don med yin/ / 'jig rten blo yis gtong ba ma go na/ /lha mi'i bde skyid la yang mi bsams na/ /tshe 'di'i skyid sdug bsam pa smos ci 'tshal/ /ji srid rnam par rtog pa ma zad bar/ /sang bya gnangs bya'i bya brel shoms mi srid/ /lings kyis bor la dam pa'i phyag phyir 'brongs/ /gdams pa'i mdzod la rang byan tshud pa dang*/ / phyi nang bdud kyi dpung gis mi thub dang*/ /tshul khrims gtsang ma ngo lkog med la sogs/ /chig skya pher na gcig pur ri khrod 'grim/ /tshul 'chos med pa'i tshul khrims gtsang ldan pas/ /zhen 'khris nye ring med pa'i phan sems kyis/ /'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed do/ /thang lhod med par sgrub la gsha' mar 'bad/ /tsha grang bkres skom srog gi bar chad sogs/ /bde sdug gang yang yid la mi byed cing*/ /snyan grags zang zing phyogs su ma shor bar/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i gdams ngag nyams su blang*/ /bya ba btang ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o//

//sems can spyod pa bsam yas shing*/ /dbang po'i bye brag bsam mi khyab/ /sbyangs pa'i khyad par thug pa med/ /rgyal ba'i theg mtha' zad pa med/ / mdor bsdus gang zag rnam pa gsum/ /sbyangs pa che chung khyad par gyis/ /rim gyis pa dang cig car ba/ /thod rgal ba yi gang zag go /rim gyis pa yi lam mchog de/ /cig car ba yi chos log yin/ /cig car ba yi lam mchog de/ / rim gyis pa yi chos log yin/ /rma bya'i zas mchog tsan dug yin/ /gzhan gyis zos na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rma bya tsan dug spangs na 'chi/ /nya yi gnas mchog chu yin te/ /mi sogs chu yis bsubs nas 'chi/ /nya ni skam la phyung na 'chi/ / tshad pa'i nad la gang phan de/ /grang ba'i nad la gnod par 'gyur/ /grang ba'i nad la gang phan de/ /tshad pa'i nad la shin tu gnod/ /gang zag gcig la'ang gnas skabs kyis/ /snga phyi'i theg pa so sor bstan/ /dman pa'i dus su gang phan de/ /mchog gi dus su 'ching bar byed/ /mchog gi dus su gang phan des// dman pa'i dus su lhung bar byed/ /tshad pa'i nad gzhi gcig pa la/ /zhugs ma thag tu bsil thang phan/ /sos la khad nas shin tu gnod/ /de phyir gnas skabs dus tshod dang*/ /dbang po mtho dman shes byas la/ /phan tshun lam la smad mi bya/ /rim gyis pa yi gang zag gis/ /dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyo ba bskyed/ /dal 'byor mi rtag bsam byas pas/ /myur du gsum la skyabs su 'gro /de rjes bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad/ /de rjes gtan khrims rnam lnga dang*/ /dge tshul dge slong rim gyis bslab/ /'khor ba'i chos las yid byung nas/ /mya ngan 'das la blo brtan cing*/ /nges par 'byung ba'i khrims ldan pas/ /bye brag mdo sde'i grub mtha' bslab/ /de rjes dman pa'i byang chub ste/ /spang phyir 'gro ba'i drin lan bsam/ /byams dang snying rje goms pa yis/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis/

/zin pa'i pha rol phyin pa drug / tshogs gnyis dag tu bsdus byas la/ /stong pa snying rje zung 'brel bas/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong goms bya zhing*/ /rang rgyud legs par sbyang bar bya/ /rang 'dod med pa'i phan sems kyis/ /rgyun chad med par gzhan don 'bad/ /de ltar sbyangs pa'i skyes bu yis/ /yan lag bdun ldan sku bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs te/ /rgyud sde bzhi la rim gyis bslab/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor bla med kyi/ /rgyud du bum pa'i dbang mnos la/ /dam tshig gtsang mar bsrung ldan pas/ /bskyed pa'i rim pas sbyang bar bya/ /de rjes gsang ba'i dbang dag gis/ /rtsa rlung rtsol bas bdag byin rlabs/ /de rjes gsum pa'i bde stong bsgom/ /bzhi pa mthar thug goms par bya/ /rim gyis gang zag zur tsam smos/ /gang zag rigs ni brjod mi lang*/ /theg pa mas 'dzeg dgos pa yod// che long bslabs pas chog pa yod/ /bslab mi dgos pa dag kyang yod/ /dbang ma bskur bar thob pa yod/ /bskur yang ma thob shin tu mang*/ /bskur na thob la ma bskur na/ /mi thob pa yi rigs kyang yod/ /ye nas dbang dang ldan pa'ang yod/ /de ltar snod kyi rigs shes nas/ /snod dang ldan pa'i lag len bya/ / rim gyis pa yi lam dang gang zag rigs ma nges par bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //cig car ba yi gang zag gis/ /lus srog dngos po ci yod kyis/ /rgyud ldan bla ma mnyes par bya/ /dbang dam byin rlabs ldan pa yis/ /byang chub sems kyis rab 'phangs la/ /lha yi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ /thog ma nyid nas nges pa'i don/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya/ /rtogs pa'i bcud ldan bla ma yis/ /rang la yod pa'i ye shes de/ /lag mthil gter bzhin ngo sprod la/ / bsgom bya sgom byed med mod kyi/ /bsgom med ngang las yengs mi bya/ /sprad phrud mang po'i zhe 'dod kyis/ /lhun grub ye shes sgrib par mchi'o/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la/

/'di bya'i tig po mi dgos so/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi/ /go rim med cing grangs nges med/ /dus tshod tshes grangs brtsi mi dgos/ /nam dran dus la glod la zhog /dang po bar dang mtha' ma med/ / rang sems skye med rgyun mi chad/ /chu rlabs snyog pa'i lang long de/ /ma snyogs rang dgar bzhag na dwangs/ /rang sems rtog pa'i sgrib g.yog 'di/ /ma bcos rang bzhag chos skur dwangs/ /bcas bcos ma byed glod la zhog /shes pa ma 'gugs yan par thongs/ /zhe 'dod ma byed chal bar zhog /dmigs gtad ma 'cha' gtal bar thongs/ /bya byed ma mang rtsen ne zhog /sems kyi bzhag sa ma 'tshol bar/ /rten med bar snang lta bur zhog /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar la/ /mi bsam shes pa so mar zhog /rnam rtog 'phro rung ma 'phros rung*/ /ched du ma bsgoms lhug par zhog /mdor na ci yang ma bsgoms par/ /shes pa gang dgar thong la thongs/ /gang la'ang nyam nga bya mi dgos/ / chos sku'i ngang las g.yos ri shi /shes pa lhod kyis glod tsa na/ /gsal la rtog pa med pa'i nyams/ /bar snang dag pa'i dkyil ltar gnas/ /de ni 'od gsal chos sku yin/ /de ltar bzhag pa'i ngang nyid las/ /rnam rtog gtol gyis skyes pa de/ /de nyid 'od gsal chos sku las/ /gzhan zhig yin snyam ma sems shig/ g.yo med rgya mtsho dwangs pa las/ /rba rlabs chil gyis langs pa de/ /de nyid rgya mtsho dwangs pa las/ /gzhan zhig min pa ji bzhin no/ /rtog pa'i gzhi ma sems yin la/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal rig yin/ /gsal rig rang bzhin stong pa ste/ /stong pa'i ngo bo bde chen yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin de la ni/ /mtshan ma'i mun pa gtan med pas/ /'od gsal bya bar ming du btags/ / rig dang stong pa dbyer med pas/ /zung 'jug bya bar ming du btags/ /chos rnams kun gyi bdag nyid de/ /rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo yin/ /rang sems rig pa'i ngo bo de/ /mtshan ma'i lus kyis stong pas na/

/lus med lus te lus kyi mchog /lus med chos nyid lus yin phyir/ /chos kyi sku zhes btags pa yin/ /de phyir rnam rtog 'phro ba de/ /stong nyid las ni stong nyid 'phro/ /chos sku las ni chos sku 'phro/ /'od gsal las ni 'od gsal 'phro/ /bde chen las ni bde chen 'phro/ /zung 'jug las ni zung 'jug 'phro/ /chos dbyings las ni chos dbyings 'phro/ /rnam dag las ni rnam dag 'phro/ /rdor sems las ni rdor sems 'phro/ /byang chub las ni byang chub 'phro/ /gdams ngag gsha' mas ma zin cing*/ /sbyangs pa'i 'phro med rmongs pa'i mis/ /'phros pa dang ni ma 'phros dang*/ /rtog pa dang ni mi rtog dang*/ /sems dang chos sku gnyis su phye/ /rnam rtog skyon du bltas shing bkag /mi rtog 'dod cing ched du bsgrubs/ /chu rlabs phyags pas phyi phyir 'khyoms/ /rtog pa bkag pa'i mi rtog pa/ /de nyid rnam rtog 'khrul pas te/ /chos sku sgrib pa'i mun chen yin/ /rtog pa 'phro bar mi 'dod gang*/ /mi rtog gnas par 'dod pa yin/ /zhe 'dod 'gong po phugs su zhugs/ / gnyug ma'i skor mdzod zad par byed/ /rnam rtog 'gegs pa'i sgom chen de/ / mar 'dod chu la bsrubs pa bzhin/ /bskal bar bsgoms kyang don mi mthong*/ /de phyir rnam rtog dgag mi dgos/ /'dug na ched du spros mi dgos// 'phros kyang chos sku 'dug kyang ni/ /chos kyi sku las g.yos pa med/ /bla ma dam pas zin gyur na/ /'phros kyang grol la 'dug kyang grol/ /bla ma dam pas ma zin na/ /'phros kyang 'ching la 'dug kyang 'ching*/ /de phyir gdams pas zin par mdzod/ /grogs su 'char bar gdon mi za/ /brtag dpyad tsab tsub ma mang bar/ /lhod kyis glod la lhan gyis zhog /phyin log rjes su ma 'breng bar/ / shes pa ci dgar thong la thongs/ /phyi rol yul la ma lta zhig /rang gi sems la'ang ma lta zhig /yul rnams stong la sems kyang stong*/

/nyam nga bag tsha bya mi dgos/ /'di yin snyam pa gang yang rung*/ /dmigs zhen sa bon thebs pa yin/ / rlom sems myu gu skyes gyur nas/ /'khor ba'i sdong po 'phel bar mchi'o/ / sems nyid ye dag 'od gsal la/ /bsgom pa'i mun pas ma bsgribs shing*/ / rtsol med 'bras bu gtor ba mchi'o/ /sems nyid rgya mtsho dwangs pa la/ /zhe 'dod rnyog ma ma bslang zhing*/ /chos sku'i nor bu bsgrib par mchi'o/ /sems nyid me long g.ya' med la/ /bsam gtan dri mas ma byugs shig /ye shes gzugs brnyan mi mthong ngo*/ /sems nyid nor bu rin chen de/ /mtshan ma'i 'jim pas ma 'thum zhing*/ /'bras bu dgos 'dod dgag par mchi'o/ /mdor na yin snyam med par zhog /ma yin snyam pa'ang med par zhog /yin snyam sems dang min snyam sems/ /phan tshun ltos pa'i 'dzin pa yin/ /yin pa gang yang med pa na/ /ma yin pa ni gang yang med/ /mnyam bral ngang du phyam gyis thong*/ /bzhag dang mi bzhag mi bsam zhing*/ /btang dang mi btang yang mi bsam/ /bsam dang mi bsam yang mi bsam/ /'gro'am 'dug gam 'greng yang rung*/ /sgom mam nyal lam za yang rung*/ /cal col smra dang nyan la sogs/ /gnyug ma'i yid kyis zin pa gces/ /bzhag thabs kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //rang sems chos sku lhun grub 'di/ /ma bcos rang dgar bzhag pa las/ /nyams kyi khyad par nges par 'char/ /rim gyis pa dang thod rgal ba/ / cig car ba dang gsum du 'dod/ /rim gyis pa yi 'char lugs ni/ /dang po gnas pa tsam du 'byung*/ /de nas nyams myong nges par 'char/ /de rjes rtogs pa lhag gis 'char/ /gnas pa dang po byung dus su/ /ri gzar log la rbab 'dril bzhin/ /rnam rtog zam ma chad par ldang*/ /sgom nyams med dam snyam pa 'ong*/ /rnam rtog byung tshad tshor ba de/ /shes pa cung zad gnas pa yin/ / gnas pa med pa'i gong rol tu/ /rnam rtog rang dgar shor ba yis/ /rtog pa 'gyus kyang ngo ma shes/ /de nas dal 'bab chu bo bzhin/

/shes pa dal zhing rnam rtog nyung*/ /mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i gting bzhin du/ /shes pa mi g.yo brtan par gnas/ /de nas nyams su myong ba 'char/ /bar snang dag pa'i dkyil lta bur/ /gsal la mi rtog bde bar myong*/ /mar me rlung gis mi bskyod bzhin/ / rang rig rang gsal yengs pa med/ /me tog mdzes la char bab bzhin/ /sa la hrig ge yal le ba/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /sing nge cha le dngos po med/ /'khar phor chu yis bkang ba bzhin/ /phyi nang med par seng nge ba/ /de 'dra'i ming la thug pa med/ /gzhi med rmi lam lta bur 'char/ /dngos med 'ja' tshon lta bur mthong*/ /'dzin med chu zla lta bur 'char/ /nam mkha'i 'dod yon longs spyod bzhin/ /ci yang myong ba med par myong*/ /ma myangs pa ni myong ba'i mchog /myong ba thams cad bral te 'gro /ma myangs pa la bral rgyu med/ /nyams su myong ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de ltar nyams su myong gyur na/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes lhag gis 'char/ / rtogs pa'i ye shes ma shar na/ /nyams myong ji ltar bzang gyur kyang*/ /shing bcad rtsa ba ma phyin bzhin/ /phyir zhing nyon mongs zug rngu 'phen/ /de phyir rtogs pa 'char ba gces/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes 'char ba ste/ /e re 'dod kyis 'char ba min/ /brtag dpyad mkhas pas 'ong ba min/ /thos pa ches pas shes pa min/ /rtog ge pa yi spyod yul min/ /rtog pa bkag pa'i mi rtog pa/ / ji tsam mthug cing tshan che yang*/ /ye shes skye ba'i sgrib chen yin/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes shugs 'byung de/ /a re 'dod dang slod pa dang*/ /brtag dpyad mkhas dang mi mkhas dang*/ /thos pa che dang thos chung dang*/ /shes rab can dang rmongs pa dang*/ /nyams myong bzang dang ngan pa dang*/ /rtsol ba drag dang zhan la sogs/ / gang gis kyang ni mi 'char te/ /bla ma'i dus thabs brten pa dang*/ /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /bla ma'i dus thabs brten zhes pa/ /rtogs ldan bla ma mnyes pa yi/

/byin rlabs stobs kyis 'char ba yin/ /bdag gi bsod nams zhes pa ni/ /sbyangs pa'i 'phro can rnams la 'char/ /de phyir rtogs pa'i ye shes de/ /byin rlabs lam la gnas pa'i phyir/ /dad pa can gyi spyod yul yin/ /gus pa can la 'char ba yin/ /sbyangs pa can gyis rtogs pa yin/ / kun gyi grogs ni brtson 'grus yin/ /skal ldan dbang po rab kyis mthong*/ / tshig mkhan rnams kyi blor mi shong*/ /de 'dra'i gang zag skal ldan la/ /gnyis med rtogs pa 'char ba de/ /bla ma dam pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /rtogs pa'i dkyil nas chos sku 'char/ /sems nyid dkyil nas gnyis med 'char/ / nyon mongs dkyil nas ye shes 'char/ /nyams myong dkyil nas rtogs pa shar/ / gnyid log skyes bu sad pa ltar/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba sangs kyis song*/ / gnyis med ye shes phral gyis sad/ /a pa de tsug 'dug pa la/ /snga nas ma rtogs 'phyug song snyam/ /gnyis med ye shes a re dga'/ /sngon chad spyod pa ngo re tsha/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs zer ba yi/ /'khor 'das sa mtshams de ring phyed/ /sngon chad ma rtogs gong rol tu/ /dper na mi zhig gnyid log pa'i/ /rmi lam rmi ba'i dus tsam na/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams pa rmis/ /dmyal sogs sdug bsngal myong ba rmis/ /sun pas bla ma bsten pa rmis/ /gdams ngag nyams su blangs pa rmis/ /nyams myong sems la shar ba rmis/ /'od gsal chos sku shar ba rmis/ /rtog pa'i mun nag sangs pa rmis/ /mnyam bzhag rjes thob med pa rmis/ /de nas rtogs pa shar ba rmis/ /ma rtogs pa yi sems can la/ /dmigs med snying rje shar ba rmis/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog thob nas// gzugs sku 'gro don lhun grub rmis/ /gnyid de phral gyis sad dus na/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba med/ /sun pas bla ma bsten pa med/ /gdams ngag nyams su blangs pa med/ /nyams myong ye shes shar ba med/ /'od gsal chos sku shar ba med/

/rnam rtog mun pa sangs pa med/ /mi rtog pa la gnas pa med/ /ye shes rtogs pa shar ba med/ /sems can med cing snying rje med/ / byang chub med cing thob pa'ang med/ /'gro ba med cing don byed med/ /bden pa med cing brdzun pa'ang med/ /rmi lam snang ba tsam du zad/ /rmi lam rmis pa'i 'khor ba de/ /gang nas byung zhing gang du song*/ /'khor spangs mya ngan 'das pa de/ /gang nas byung zhing gang du song*/ /de sogs rmi lam chos rnams kun/ /gang nas byung zhing gang du song*/ /dper na rgyal po chen po zhig /gdan las skad cig ma g.yos par/ /sgyu ma'i rta phos kha khyer te/ /la dgu lung dgu rgal ba dang*/ /bde sdug sna tshogs nyams myong zhing*/ /lo zla mang po lon mod kyi/ / rgyal po gdan las ma g.yos shing*/ /snga dro tsam yang lon pa med/ /rtogs pa de ltar shar ba yis/ /shes rab chen pos skad cig la/ /chos kun rang bzhin khong du chud/ /chud do snyam pa'i rlom sems med/ /gnyis med ye shes mngon du gyur/ /gyur snyam du yang rlom sems med/ khams gsum theg pa dman las grol/ /grol snyam du yang rlom sems med/ /gnyis med rtogs pa'i skad cig la/ /snang grags sems su thag chod pas/ /rnam bcas grub mtha' mngon du gyur/ /sems nyid gsal bar thag chod pas/ /rnam med grub mtha' mngon du gyur/ /rang rig sgyu ma ltar shes pas/ /sgyu ma'i smra ba'i grub mtha' rdzogs/ /sgyu ma stong par shes pa yis/ /rab tu mi gnas grub mtha' rdzogs/ /stong pa bde bar shar ba yis/ /gnyis med zung 'jug lta ba rdzogs/ /zung 'jug yid la mi byed pas/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon du gyur/ /gyur snyam du yang 'du shes med//

de ltar rtogs pa'i ye shes de/ /gang nas kyang ni ma 'ongs la/ /gang du yang ni mi 'gro ste/ /gar yang gnas pa med pa'o/ /rtogs bya rtogs bya'i ye shes gnyis/ /mi rtog chos kyi dbyings su thim/ /dbyings las 'du shes rlom pa med/ /mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid la gnas/ /smra bsam thams cad 'chal ba'i rgyu/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag ltos/ /nga yis rtsed mo byas pa la/ /byis pa rnams kyi a thang chad/ /yod na bla ma rje btsun mchod/ /med na shes pa glod la zhog /de tsho rim gyis gang zag yin/ /thod rgal ba yi 'char lugs ni/ / gnas dang nyams myong rtogs pa gsum/ /sngon du rtogs pa lhag gis 'char/ / rtogs kyang mi brtan rba rlabs 'dra/ /res 'ga' nyams myong res 'ga' ni/ / gnas pa 'ong ste nges pa med/ /nyams kyi mtho dman gnyis ka btsal/ /cig car ba yi gang zag la/ /rtogs pa'i bcud ldan bla ma yis/ /gdams ngag bstan ma thag tu'am/ /sems la bltas ma thag tu ni/ /nyams myong rtogs pa gnas pa gsum/ /sgom long med par dus gcig 'char/ /nyams myong 'phel 'grib byung gyur kyang*/ /rtogs pa 'gyur med brtan par gnas/ /spra spre'u yar rgyug mar rgyug kyang*/ /ljon shing 'gyur ba med par gnas/ /'ja' tshon yal rung ma yal rung*/ /nam mkha'i dbyings la 'gyur ba med/ /rba rlabs zhi rung ma zhi rung*/ /rgya mtsho'i gting la 'gyur ba med/ /rang sems chos sku lhun grub la// nyams myong khyod rang gar dgar song*/ /nyams kyi mya ngan bsal bar byed/ / rtogs pa nyams dang ma 'dres na/ /rlung dmar gseb kyi mar me bzhin/ /dang po'i las can phung por mchi/ /brtan pa thob pa'i sgom chen la/ /bzang rung ngan rung grogs su 'char/ /dang po ba rnams ma skrag cig /sgron me chung ngu'i dus su ni/ /ser bu phra mo tsam yang gnod/ /nags la me chen 'bar ba'i tshe/ / rlung dmar kun kyang grogs su 'char/ /rtogs pa nyag nyug shar gyur kyang*/ / bstan pa ma thob sgom chen rnams/

/nyams su myong ba'i shing skam gyis/ /rtogs pa'i sgron me gso ba gces/ /shing rlon mang na bsad par mchi'o/ /rtogs pa ji ltar mtho gyur kyang*/ /gnas pa nyams myong ma brtan na/ /sems la rang dbang ma thob pas/ /nyon mongs dgra bos bcings par mchi'o/ /ji ltar skyes bu gces pa zhig /dgras bzung btson chas bsdams gyur na/ /rang khyim lam ngo cha yod kyang*/ /'gro dbang med pa ji bzhin no/ /de phyir nyams myong brtan po yis/ /sems la rang dbang ma thob na/ /rtogs pa'i gter dang bral bar mchi'o/ /smra kham che ba'i kha na med/ /gzobs kyin mdzod cig sgom chen kun// kha tsho nyams dang 'gal bar mchi'o/ /gnyis med rtogs pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu la/ / nyams su myong ba'i mdog phyung ste/ /spyod pa'i nus pas dgos 'dod skong*/ / rim gyis pa yi gang zag gis/ /gsang sngags lam la zhugs ma thag /mi dge'i bsam pa thag bsrings la/ /'khor ba'i chos la yid phyung ste/ /byang chub chen por yid brtan pas/ /rang 'dod med pa'i bsam pa yis/ /'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed la/ /lha yi nga rgyal ma bral bas/ /bzlas brjod maṇ+ḍal gtor ma dang*/ /mchod sogs yan lag bdun pa dang*/ /yi dwags rnams la gtor ma dang*/ /chu sbyin klu rnams gso ba dang*/ /yod na bla ma bsnyen bkur dang*/ /dge 'dun ston mo tshogs 'khor dang*/ /slong ba kun la phangs med sbyin/ /phyi dang nang gi sbyin bsreg bya/ /tsha tsha mchod rten sku gzugs bzhengs/ / srog chags tshe bskyab gsung rab bklag /mdor na thun rdzogs thun bar du/ / snying rje chen pos kun bslangs nas/ /dge ba 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa/ /lung ma bstan du'ang mi bsdad na/ /mi dge'i spyod pa smos ci dgos/ /shin tu btsun pa'i dge slong ngam/ /bag ma gsar pa'i tshul bzung nas/ /spyod lam bag dang ldan pa yis/ /skye dgu dge ba'i chos dang bstun/

/phyi nang sgrib pa sbyang bya zhing*// bsod nams tshogs la 'bad par bya/ /yon tan gsang la lkog tu spel/ / las 'bras khyad du gang gsod de/ /kun rdzob thabs la bskur ba 'debs/ / 'dab gshog bral ba'i bya bzhin du/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar nges par lhung*/ / de phyir mi dge phra nas spang*/ /dge ba phra nas bsgrub par bya/ /de ltar dge ba'i sbyor ba las/ /rgyun mi chad par brtson ldan pas/ /cung zad brtan pa thob gyur nas/ /spyod pa phyi nang gnyis su dbye/ /tshogs spyod skye bo rnams dang bstun/ / dben par nang spyod ting 'dzin spel/ /nang spyod nyams myong spel ba'i tshe/ /dang po'i las pas ma tshor bar/ /ting 'dzin rtogs pa gang 'phel ba'i/ /spyod pa nyams dang bstun zhing bya/ /mi 'chi bcu phyed spyad bya zhing*/ /stobs lnga dag kyang brten par bya/ /'dod yon bcu phyed mi spang zhing*/ /zhen pa spangs la grogs su 'khyer/ /zhing pa'i 'bras kyi myu gu de/ /chu lud 'dzoms pas rgyas par byed/ / rnal 'byor ye shes myu gu de/ /'dod yon brten pas rgyas par byed/ /skye med nyams dang ma bral bas/ /gang yang zhen pa med par spyad/ /tshogs drug rang spyod lhug pa 'di/ /gnyis med rtogs pas zin byas la/ /'di bya 'di mi bya med par/ /spyod lam gar dgar btang bar bya/ /gnyis med rtogs pa'i nyams myong gis/ /gos la 'di gyon mi gyon med/ /bzang rung ngan rung gyon par bya/ /zas la 'di za mi za med/ /gtsang rung btsog rung bza' bar bya/ / mi rtog ye shes 'phel bar 'gyur/ /ngag la 'di smra mi smra med/ /bla rtol lta bur smra bar bya/ /gang yang ched du bcos mi bya/ /rang byung lhug par gnas par bya/ / chos sku'i nyams dang bral mi bya/ /gang la'ang zhen pa med par bya/ /rang gi 'khor ram gzhan dag gis/ /legs nyes la sogs gang byas kyang*/ /skad cig tsam yang 'khrug mi bya/ /bem po bzhin du gnas par bya/ /sems la gnod pa'i bya ba rnams/

/nam du yang ni mi bya'o/ /ri dwags mi la 'bros pa bzhin/ /rtag tu mi la bros par bya/ /bdag bzang snyems pas gzhan dag la/ kho bzang kho ngan shan mi dbye/ khram pas rang mtshang sbed pa bzhin/ /rang gi yon tan rtag tu sba/ /mi chen ldir ka mi bya zhing*/ /rtag tu dman sa bzung bar bya/ /mtho dman med par rtogs gyur kyang*/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro rtag tu mchod/ /mdor na rang 'dod g.yo sgyu dang*/ /bcos ma thams cad spang bar bya// ji srid mnyam bzhag rjes thob gnyis/ /yod pa de srid mnyam bzhag la/ / shes pa brtan nam mi brtan brtag /mnyam bzhag shes pa mi brtan na/ /mag ma mug mar mgo btums nas/ /blun sgom byas pas don go med/ /byams dang snying rjes kun bslangs nas/ /lus ngag dge la 'bad par bya/ /'on te mnyam bzhag brtan gyur na/ /lus ngag dge sbyor chag kyang bla'i/ /mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig goms su gzhug /mnyam bzhag rjes thob zer ba de/ /langs 'dug gnyis la zer ba min/ /dang po'i las pas mnyam bzhag ni/ /dge ba'i dmigs pa gang rung la/ /rtse gcig mi g.yo sems brtan na/ /'gro 'dug byas kyang mnyam bzhag yin/ /dmigs pa rtse gcig mi gnas par/ /rnam rtog rang dgar shor gyur na/ /mal du bsgoms kyang rjes thob yin/ /rang sems rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag ni/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pas shes/ /rtse gcig rnal 'byor shar dus su/ /rang gi sems kyi rang bzhin rtogs/ /bar snang dag pa'i dkyil lta bu/ /gsal stong ma 'gags mtha' dbus med/ /sing nge ye re gnas pa de/ /rnal 'byor dang po'i mnyam bzhag yin/ /de las rnam rtog 'phros pa de/ /mal na bsgoms kyang rjes thob yin/ /gsal stong ying nge ye re ba/ /gnas na lab lab 'go 'dug kyang*/ /mnyam bzhag ngang la gnas pa yin/ /spros bral rnal 'byor shar dus su/ /rang gi sems kyi ngo bo rtogs/ / rig pa spros bral rgyun chad med/ /skye 'gag blang dor med pa yi/ /rang sems chos skur gnas pa de/

/rnal 'byor gnyis pa'i mnyam bzhag yin/ /mnyam bzhag de la gnas pa na/ /'gro dang lab lob smra byed kyang*/ /mnyam bzhag ngang la gnas pa yin/ /spros pa'i mtshan mas yengs gyur na/ /mal na bsgoms kyang rjes thob yin/ /ro gcig rnal 'byor shar dus su/ /rang gi sems kyi mtshan nyid rtogs/ /rang sems spros bral chos sku las/ /'khor 'das du mar shar ba rtogs/ /rnam par rtog dang mi rtog dang*/ /snang dang snang med gnas pa dang*/ /mi gnas stong dang mi stong dang*/ /gsal dang mi gsal sna tshogs kun/ /'od gsal chos sku ro gcig pas/ /chos sku min pa'i snang ma mthong*/ / 'od gsal min pa'i rtags ma mthong*/ /de ltar ro mnyam rtogs pa de/ /yid kyis zin pa'i dus tshod de/ /rnal 'byor gsum pa'i mnyam bzhag yin/ / gnyug ma'i yid kyis zin gyur na/ /mchong rgyug lab lob smra byed kyang*/ /mnyam bzhag ngang la gnas pa yin/ /gnyug ma'i yid dang bral gyur na/ /mal na bsgoms kyang rjes thob yin/ /sgom med rnal 'byor shar dus su/ /rig pa'i ngo bo rten dang bral/ /rnal 'byor pa la bsgom rgyu med/ /sgom mkhan mi 'dug phyal bar song*/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan gyi/ /sangs rgyas rang la tshang ngo zer/ /'di rang yin par da gdod shes/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub de/ / 'di rang yin par don thag chod/ /ye nas gnas pa'i dngos grub la/ /thob bo snyam pa'i rlom sems med/ /dran pas zin dang ma zin med/ /yid la byed dang mi byed med/ /ro gcig yin dang ma yin med/ /gnyis med shes pa rang so la/ /mnyam bzhag rjes thob rim pa med/ /rig stong rgyun chad med pa la/ / 'chi ba med cing skye ba med/ khyung rtsal sgong shun nang nas rdzogs/ /sgong shun dang bral nam 'phang gcod/ /sku gsum yon tan sems la rdzogs/ /lus rgya zhig nas gzhan don 'char/ /de ltar sgom med shar ba la/ /mnyam bzhag rjes thob rim pa med/ /rtogs pa ji ltar mtho yang rung*/

/ji srid goms su yod bar du/ /mnyam bzhag rjes thob gnyis su yod/ /dran pas zin dang ma zin yod/ /yengs dang ma yengs gnyis su yod/ /goms su med par shar tsam na// sgom du med ces de la bya/ /de la mnyam bzhag rjes thob med/ /rtag tu mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig yin/ /'gro'am 'dug gam nyal yang rung*/ /gnyid dang rmi lam rmi yang rung*/ /lab lob smra dang za yang rung*/ /gnyug ma'i rtogs pa'i yid kyis khyab/ /thams cad mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig yin/ /nor bu dgos 'dod rang chas yin/ /nyi ma 'od dang rang chas yin/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu mnyam bzhag yin/ /gnyis med mngon gyur de la zer/ /rtse gcig dus kyi rjes thob 'di/ /dngos po a 'thas nyid du snang*/ /snang yang sgyu mar bsgom par bya/ / spros bral dus kyi rjes thob 'di/ /res 'ga' sgyu mar 'char yang ni/ /res 'ga' a 'thas nyid du 'ong*/ /'ong yang chos skur bsgom par bya/ /ro gcig dus kyi rjes thob 'di/ /dran pas zin tshe chos skur 'char/ /ma zin a 'thas yad yud tsam/ /sgom du med la mnyam bzhag dang*/ /rjes thob chos sku 'ba' zhig de/ /gzugs sku gnyis po gzhan snang ngo*/ /smra kham che ba'i kha na med/ /phye gtor 'gam pa'i kha na med/ /rang mgo rang gis ma btums shig /sgom du med pa'i dus tshod ni/ /gnyid log ma log med par gsal/ /rtogs dpyod byas rung ma byas rung*/ /dran pas zin rung ma zin rung*/ /bdag med gzhan med chos skur gsal/ /dmigs med thugs rjes 'bad rtsol gyis/ /rnam rtog med par shugs kyis 'char/ /de 'dra'i dus las ma phyin par/ khang stong yug po'i sgom chen gyis/ /rang gis rang nyid bslus par mchi'o/ /de ltar skal ldan sgom chen rnams/ /sgom med sa la slebs kyi bar/ /bla ma bkur zhing bsod nams bsags/ khang stong yug pos ma bslus na/ /bsod nams tshogs kyis bslus pa med/ /rtogs ldan rnams kyi snying gtam yin/

/tshogs dang dben pa'i khyad par ni/ /chos sku'i ye shes 'bral med cing*/ /gnyis 'dzin zhen pa dang bral bas/ /chos brgyad phyogs su mi 'chor na/ /tshogs na 'khyams kyang dben pa yin/ /gnyis 'dzin zhen pa dang bcas pas/ /bde sdug la sogs yid byed na/ /dben par bsdad kyang tshogs pa yin/ /de phyir dben rung tshogs kyang rung*/ /gnyis med rtogs dang ma bral bas/ /skyid sdug yid la mi byed cing*/ /gang la'ang zhen pa med pa gces/ /tshogs dang dben par dbye ba dang*/ /mnyam bzhag rjes thob sogs dbye ba/ /dang po'i las pa'i gang zag rnams/ /drang phyir dgongs te gsungs pa yin/ /nges pa'i don la tshogs dben dang*/ /mnyam rjes la sogs gnyis su med/ /ci phyir zhe na sems nyid 'di/ / lhan cig skyes pa chos sku yin/ /snang ba lhan skyes chos sku'i 'od/ /mar me mar me'i 'od bzhin no/ /rig pa chos sku'i ngo bo la/ /rgyun chad 'phel 'grib mi srid phyir/ /mnyam rjes la sogs gang la srid/ /de rtogs brtan pa'i sgom chen la/ /mnyam rjes med pa su yis khegs/ /de phyir gang zag tshod ma 'dzin/ / nyams myong rtogs pa gang gces na/ /nyams myong mi gces rtogs pa gces/ / nyams myong ji ltar bzang gyur kyang*/ /rtogs pa med na grol mi srid/ /rtogs pa ji tsam mtho gyur kyang*/ /snying rje med na nyan thos lam/ /bsam gtan bzhi la sogs rnams la/ /nyams myong ting 'dzin yod med kyi/ /rtogs pa med pa'i skyon chen gyis/ /nyams myong zad nas phyir la yang*/ /ngan song la sogs ltung nas ni/ /sdug bsngal mi zad myong la ltos/ /nyams myong thams cad 'dus byas yin/ /'dus byas thams cad mi rtag 'jig /de phyir nyams myong ma zhen par// gnyis med ye shes rtogs par gyis/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa de/ /rtogs pa kho na'i spyod yul yin/ /blo yis byas pa'i gnyis med de/ /thos pa che bas rtogs gyur te/ /nang nas 'char ba'i gnyis med 'di/

/bla ma'i byin rlabs 'ba' zhig yin/ /dad ldan bla ma la gus te/ /nang nas rtogs pa'i ye shes skye/ /brtag dpyad mkhan la ci bya yod/ /tshig tu shes pa ngas kyang byas/ / sems la rtogs pa shar gyur kyang*/ /rkyen ngan thub bam mi thub brtag / g.yas nas sta res gshog byed cing*/ /mi snyan sna tshogs brjod par byed/ / g.yon nas tsan dan dris mchod cing*/ /gus pas snyan pa sna tshogs bsgrag / de 'dra'i skyid sdug myong dus su/ /ched du bsran pa ma yin par/ /bde sdug dga' mi dga' med na/ /smyon spyod tshogs su phyung pas chog /'on kyang ma dad sgyur la sogs/ /nus pa thogs med ma thob par/ /gsang bar bya ba'i spyod pa rnams/ /tshogs su spyad na bdag gzhan brlag /gzhan don 'grub mi 'grub sogs kyi/ /mngon shes sna tshogs shar ba dang*/ /nus pa thogs med thob gyur nas/ /gsang spyod tshogs spyod dbye ba med/ /rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas ni/ / dge bcu spyad du med par gda'/ /sdig bcu spang du med par gda'/ /ma bcos lhug par bzhag ces gsungs/ /rje btsun lo ras zhal nas kyang*/ / mtho la gnyan gyi dkon mchog gsum/ /bkur med rig pa'i ngang du rdzogs/ /

skyabs 'gro bya sa ma rnyed gsungs/ /rje btsun rnams pa'i dgongs pa de/ /zhang gi sprang ban bdag dang ni/ /rtogs ldan rdo rje spun rnams la/ /bum nang mar me bzhin du gsal/ /bshad na khyed kyis go bar dka'/ /dad ldan bla ma mnyes byed cing*/ /byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa yi/ /rang shar rnams kyi spyod yul yin/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod pa dang*/ /mnyam bzhag chen po'i spyod la sogs/ /mang gis dogs nas 'dir ma gleng/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i rgyud mchog ltos/ /'dir mang smra ba'i kha na med/ /bab col tho co ma byed par/ /spyod pa dus dang 'brel bar gyis/ /sgrub pa thang lhod med par gyis/ /lta ba phyogs ris med par gyis/ /spyod pa tshul 'chos med par gyis/ /snying rje phyogs ris med par gyis/ /sgom pa yengs pa med par gyis/ /yon tan zad pa med pa 'byung*/ /'gro don thug pa med par 'grub/ /gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i/ /btsan thabs bcos ma tho co yis/ /dgra zun gser dang bong ba mnyam/ / ya tshul tshul 'chos ma byas kyang*/ /grol na bu chung cis mi grol/ /gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i/ /gza' gtad med pas grol 'gyur na/ /smyon pa thams cad grol bar rigs/ /gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i/ /gtsang btsog med pas grol gyur na/ khyi phag rnams kyang grol bar rigs/ /gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i/ /spyod lam mkhas pas grol gyur na/ /bag ma rnams kyang grol bar 'gyur/ /gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin pa'i/ /rang byung lhug pas grol gyur na/ /glang glen rnams kyang grol bar rigs/ /gnyis med rtogs pas zin gyur na/ /spyod pa rtsing rung zhib kyang rung*/ /ji ltar spyad kyang grol bar 'gyur/ /gnyis med rtogs pas ma zin na/ /zhib rung rtsing rung 'ching bar 'gyur/ /phyogs med snying rjes khyab gyur na/ /ji ltar spyad kyang mchog gi lam/ /phyogs med snying rjes ma zin na/

/ji ltar spyad kyang dman pa'i lam/ /spyod pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //dam tshig ji ltar bsrung zhe na/ /dang po'i las pa'i dus tshod du/ /so so thar pa'i sdom pa sogs/ /bde gshegs bla ma'i bka' mi bcag /rtsa rlung sgom pa'i dus tshod du/ /bde drod mi mthun phyogs rnams spangs/ /mi rtog nyams myong shar gyur nas/ /ting 'dzin 'gal rkyen thams cad spang*/ /rang sems ngo bo mthong gyur nas/ /sems la gnod pa thams cad spang*/ /gnyis med rtogs pa shar nas ni/ /ched du bya ba thams cad spang*/ /kun la rang sems dpang por zhog /dbyings las mi 'da'i don rtogs nas/ /srung du med de dam tshig mchog /dkar po chig thub bya ba yin/ /dam tshig gi le'u ste dgu pa'o// // lta ba phyin ci ma log cing*/ /gdams ngag snod tshod ma 'phyugs dang*/ / sgom pa ma nor thang lhod med/ /spyod pa zhen med skyon ma gos/ /dam tshig lha yis ma khrel dang*/ /'bras bu dgos 'dod gdon mi za/ /dper na sman gyi sdong po bzhin/ /zhing sa sa bon dus tshod dang*/ /chu lud rten 'brel ma 'phyugs na/ /myu gus kyang ni nad sel na/ /sdong bu yal ga lo 'dab dang*/ /me tog 'bras bu thams cad kyis/ /tshod ka tshod ka'i yon tan gyis/ /nad rnams sel ba ji bzhin no/ /log pa'i rten 'brel rnams kyis kyang*/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byin nus na/ /ma nor legs pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /bde legs 'bras 'byin smos ci dgos/ /gnyis 'dzin 'dus byas rten 'brel gyis/ / bde sdug 'bras bu 'byin nus na/ /ltos med dus min bsam yas kyis/ /ye shes mtha' yas smos ci dgos/ /dngos por zhen pa'i dge rtsas kyang*/ /mtho ris bde ba thob byed na/ /dmigs med dge rtsa bsam yas kyis/ /rdzogs sangs rgya ba smos ci dgos/ /zhen bcas bde gsal mi rtog gis/ khams gsum lha yi bde thob na/ /zhen med bde gsal mi rtog gis/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsum smos ci dgos/

/thabs shes bral ba'i stong nyid kyis/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bde thob na/ /stong pa snying rje dbyer med pas/ /mi gnas bde ba smos ci dgos/ /dang po'i las pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /skyed rim mnyam rjes ma 'phyugs pas/ /rab kyis zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs/ /tshe 'di nyid la mngon du gyur/ /yang na bar dor mngon du byed/ /yang na phyi mar lha yi lus/ / phun sum tshogs pa nges thob nas/ /zung 'jug longs sku mngon du byed/ /yang na skye ba bdun rnams su/ /ma lus 'ba' zhig brgyud nas 'grub/ /'bring gis mtshan bcas rdzogs rim gyis/ /nyams su myong ba skyes pa'i tshe/ /skad cig de la sdig pa'i tshogs/ /'dag cing mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs/ /bde gsal mi rtog nyams myong de/ /goms pas rtogs pa nges par 'char/ /sku gsum mngon du nges par byed/ /yang na bar dor nges par byed/ /shin tu brtson ldan rnal 'byor pas/ /man ngag zab mos zin gyur na/ /gnyis med rtogs pa ma shar yang*/ /rnam shes gzhan gyi grong 'jug dang*/ /gong du 'pho ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /mngon sum nyid du 'pho bar 'gyur/ /ma nus kyang ni bar dor 'char/ / rab kyis 'od gsal mngon du byed/ /'bring gis sgyu lus zung 'jug 'grub/ / tha mas mngal gyi grong khyer legs/ /yang na gar skye rang dbang thob/ /de nas sku gsum gdon mi za/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor pas/ /shes pa lhod kyis glod pa'i tshe/ /gsal la rtog pa med pa'i nyams/ /bar snang dag pa'i dkyil ltar 'char/ /de ltar shar ba'i dus nyid du/ /sdig sgrib dpag med nges par 'dzad/ /nges pa'i shes pa ma skyes kyang*/ /chos kyi sku dang mjal ba yin/ / gnyis med lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /rtogs pa lhag gis shar ba'i tshe/ /skad cig nyid la thog med nas/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa ji snyed rnams/ /ma lus gtan nas 'joms par byed/ /mun pa'i nang du sgron me bzhin/ /phyag rgya chen po chig chod la/

/rmongs pa sa lam brtsi ba 'khrul/ /'on kyang rmongs pa dga' ba'i phyir// mtshan nyid theg pa'i sa lam rnams/ /'dir yang 'dod pas brtsi bar bya/ / rtogs pa lhag gis shar ba de/ /mthong lam rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /ngo mnyam rtogs pa de nyid la/ /goms par byed pa sgom pa'i lam/ /sgom du med na mthar phyin lam/ /gnyis med rtogs ma thag nyid du/ /sdug bsngal sangs par ma gyur cing*/ /yon tan nus pa ma skyes kyang*/ /mthong lam min zhes su zhig smod/ /nang par nyi ma shar ma thag /chab rom zhu bar ma nus shing*/ /sa rdo dros par ma gyur kyang*/ /nyi ma min zhes su zhig smos/ /sa dang lam gyi rim pa dang*/ / drod rtags khyad par so so kun/ /rim 'jug gdul bya drang don du/ /thub pas ldem por gsungs pa la/ /rmongs rnams nyi tshe'i phyogs char zhen/ /gdul bya'i mtho dman bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas gsung rab bsam mi khyab/ /rang rang gzhung dang ma mthun yang*/ /smad cing spang bar mi bya zhing*/ /nam zhig go bar smon lam thob/ /phyag rgya chen po chig chod ma/ /pa na se yi 'bras bu bzhin/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu dus mtshungs shing*/ /mtshan ma rang sar grol ba yin/ /spre'u rnams mas 'dzegs shing thog len/ khra rnams thog babs kho nas len/ khwa rnams yal ga ma mthong ste/ /shing thog len la smrar ci yod/ /de bzhin cig car gang zag gis/ /sa lam drod rtags ma mthong yang*/ /chos sku mthong ba smrar ci yod/ /sbyangs dang nus pas so so yin/ /gnyug ma rtogs pa'i skad cig nas/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyal srid 'thob/ /thob med sems nyid dag pa 'di/ / 'bras bu yin par da gdod shes/ /shes pas ma brtags 'du shes med/ /rang grol mnyam rjes skye shi med/ /sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /rdo rje 'chang chen nyid du grol/ /de lta bu yi kun mkhyen te/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib pa gnyis/ /byung ba'i stobs kyis 'thob par bshad/ /'di yang tshogs gnyis rdzogs pas te/

/sgrib pa gnyis kyang shugs kyis 'byung*/ /gnyis med rtogs pa'i skad cig la/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyes pas/ /bsod nams tshogs chen de ru rdzogs/ /ser sna la sogs nyon mongs kyi/ /sgrib pa'i sa bon gtan nas byang*/ /rtogs pa goms par byed pa'i tshe/ /shes sgrib phra mo yod mod kyi/ / sgom du med pa'i skad cig la/ /ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs par byas/ /'khor gsum rtogs pa'i shes bya yi/ /sgrib pa'i sa bon gtan nas 'byung*/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub ces bya'o/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub yin/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'bras bu'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de ltar lta ba'i gnas lugs dang*/ /sgom pa spyod pa dam tshig dang*/ / 'bras bu la sogs chos rnams kun/ /rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ / sems nyid rang rig gsal ba'i ngang*/ /gsal tsam nyid na rang bzhin stong*/ / mkha' ltar ris su chad pa med/ /phyogs med mtha' dbus ngos bzung med/ / de lta bu yi sems nyid la/ /blta bya lta byed gnyis med pas/ /lta ba med cing rtogs pa'ang med/ /bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis med pas/ /sgom pa med cing nyams myong can/ /goms bya goms byed gnyis med pas/ /goms pa med cing ma goms med/ /yengs pa yengs mkhan gnyis med pas/ /ma yengs med cing yengs pa'ang med/ /spyad rgyu spyod mkhan gnyis med pas/ /spyod pa med cing spyad pa'ang med/ /thob bya thob byed gnyis med pas/ /sgrub pa med cing 'thob pa'ang med/ /nam mkha' stong pa'i dkyil lta bur/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis med pas/ /skyed pa med cing smin pa med/ /ye nas stong pa'i sems nyid la/ / sgrib pa med cing byang ba'ang med/ /bem min rig stong dbyer med pas/ /ye shes med cing mi shes med/ /de ltar lta sgom spyod pa dang*/ /dam tshig dang ni 'bras bu rnams/ /sems nyid 'od gsal ngo bor ni/

/mnyam par shes pa'i sgom chen la/ /blta bya lta byed zhen med pas/ /zhen med lta ba'i rgyal po yin/ /bsgom bya sgom byed zhen med pas/ /zhen med sgom pa'i rgyal po yin/ /spyad bya spyod byed zhen med pas/ /zhen med spyod pa'i rgyal po yin/ /thob bya thob byed zhen med pas/ /zhen med 'bras bu'i rgyal po yin/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //rang sems rtogs pa'i skad cig mar/ /dkar po'i yon tan ma lus pa/ / bsgrubs pa med par dus gcig rdzogs/ /sems nyid bar snang lta bu la/ /sku gsum ye nas lhun gyis grub/ /sangs rgyas dkon mchog de ru rdzogs/ / sems nyid spros bral 'dod chags bral/ /dam chos dkon mchog de ru rdzogs/ / rang bzhin skye med phyir mi ldog /rnam rtog sna tshogs grogs su shar/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog de ru rdzogs/ /de ltar dkon mchog gsum po yang*/ /rang sems rig par rdzogs pas na/ /gzhan la skyabs su 'gro ma dgos/ /nges pa'i skyabs 'gro de ru rdzogs/ /sems nyid spros dang bral ba la/ /zhe 'dod rang don gzhi med pas/ /smon pa byang sems de ru rdzogs/ /thams cad 'khrul bar go ba yis/ /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje shar/ /gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa yis/ /'jug pa'i byang sems de ru rdzogs/ /sems nyid bar snang lta bu la/ /'dzin chags bdud dang bral bas na/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ /mtshan ma'i dri ma dag pas na/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ / stong pa nyid la mi skrag cing*/ khong khro'i sa bon bcom pas na/ /bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ /rig stong rgyun chad med pa'i phyir/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ /rtse gcig ye nas lhun grub pas/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ /log rtog mtshan ma rang grol bas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ /cir snang grogs su shar ba yis/ /thabs chen bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs/

/gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs pas/ /ye shes tshogs chen de ru rdzogs/ /sems nyid bar snang lta bu la/ /lus kyi dri ma gtan med pas/ /bum pa'i dbang chen de ru rdzogs/ /ngag gi dri ma ye dag pas/ /gsang ba'i dbang chen de ru rdzogs/ /yid kyi dri ma'i gnas med pas/ /shes rab ye shes de ru rdzogs/ /cha mnyam dri ma'i gnas med pas/ /bzhi pa'i dbang mchog de ru rdzogs/ /rang rig rang gsal go ma 'gags/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan cir yang snang*/ /bskyed rim mtha' dag de ru rdzogs/ /gsal ba ngos bzung med pa yis/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa de ru rdzogs/ /rang sems 'od gsal gnyis su med/ /lhag gis rtogs pas mthong ba'i lam/ /rgyun chad med pa sgom pa'i lam/ /'bad rtsol med par mthar phyin lam/ /gang yang 'gag med drod rtags mchog /sa lam drod rtags de ru rdzogs/ /ci yang ma yin chos kyi sku/ / ci yang snang ba sprul pa'i sku/ /cir snang chos skur longs spyod pas/ /'bras bu sku gsum de ru rdzogs/ /rang rig bar snang lta bu la/ /phyogs ris med pas lta ba rdzogs/ /dmigs zhen med pas sgom pa rdzogs/ /blang dor med pas spyod pa rdzogs/ /nyams pa med pas dam tshig rdzogs/ /lhun gyis grub pas 'bras bu rdzogs/ /sems nyid 'od gsal stong pa la/ /snga phyi dus gsum phyogs cha med/ /ji srid bdag 'dzin yod kyi bar/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras dam tshig yod/ / las dang las kyi rnam smin yod/ /sdig spangs bsod nams bsag pa gces/ / dkar po chig thub tu bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //zhang gi sprang ban bdag la ni/ /nye gnas chos kyi blo gros kyis/ / bskul nas rang gi sems nyid kyi/ /gnas lugs sgro bskur ye med la/ / gdul bya 'ga' zhig drang ba'i phyir/ /sgro btags nas ni yi ger bkod/ /rkyen shar cir yang snang ba'i phyir/ /brtse bas byis pas nyes pa med/ /dag pa 'di dang dge gzhan rnams/

/ma lus gcig tu gyur nas ni/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro don du/ /gnyis med chos sku mngon 'gyur shog /'bad pa med pa'i 'gro don du/ /zhen bral dmigs med thugs rje yis/ /gzugs sku nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pas/ /gang 'dul de la der ston shog /deng nas brtsams te dus kun tu/ /dal 'byor phun tshogs lus thob nas/ /dad dang shes rab snying rje yis/ /stobs chen dge spyod 'ba' zhig shog /kun tu rdo rje theg mchog snod/ /rab gyur bla ma gdams ngag dang*/ /rtogs mchog thugs rje byin rlabs can/ /rnyed nas rtag tu mnyes byed shog /kun tu bla ma'i yon tan mthong*/ / skyon rnams gcig kyang ma mthong bas/ /rdor 'dzin nyid du rtag mthong ste/ /dad gus rgyun chad med par shog /kun slong ngan pas ma sbags pa'i/ /dmigs med snying rje chen po yis/ /bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yon tan ma lus bdag la shog /rtag chad mu mthas ma gos pa'i/ /phyogs bral lta ba rnam dag dang*/ /zhen med bde gsal mi rtog dang*/ /ro snyoms spyod pas mchog thob shog /kun tu g.yo sgyu tshul 'chos dang*/ /nyon mongs dri mas ma gos pa'i/ / dam tshig mkha' 'gros ma khel bas/ /bsrung zhing bsgrub la rtag brtson shog

/ rtag tu ri khrod 'grim byed cing*/ /'jigs skyo bar chad gtan mi 'byung*/ / nyams myong rtogs pa drod rtags sogs/ /yon tan rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan shog / bdag gis spyod lam ci byas kun/ /bla ma kun dang mched kun dang*/ /sems can gzhan dag ma lus pa/ /kun gyi yid du 'ong bar shog /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ /gnas dang gos dang ming dang rus/ /mthong thos dran dang reg sogs kyis/ /gzhan dag ci 'dod kun rdzogs shog /dngos kun chags med gtong byed cing*/ /re 'dod la sogs skyon dang bral/ /rnam dag khrims ldan sems mi 'khrug /brtan spro mi yengs mkhas rtogs shog /bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brtan thob nas/ /'od gsal zung 'jug mthar phyin te/ / bdag gi byin rlabs lhun grub kyis/ /'gro kun re ba skong bar shog /bdag gis dmigs med snying rje yis/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpag med kyis/ /lha klu gnod sbyin bdud la sogs/ /mthu chen dregs pa kun 'dul shog /bdag gi mgo dang rkang lag dang*/ /sha khrag srog dbugs la sogs pas/ /gzhan phan dus la bab gyur na/ /sprau zhing legs gtong mi 'gyod shog /zas skom bu nor bzhon pa sogs/ /longs spyod sna tshogs gang 'dod la/ /bdag gis ci dgos zad med kyis/ /phan 'dogs nga rgyal med par shog /dgra dang gdon gyis gang nyen dang*/ /nad dang mu ge la sogs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal gang gis nyes kyang rung*/ /bdag gi mthu dpal gyis skyobs shog /deng nas brtsams te dus kun tu/ /gzhan don 'ba' zhig spyod byed cing*/ /gzhan gyis mi rigs gang byas la/ /yid 'khrugs skyai med phan 'dogs shog /rlom sems nga rgyal phrag dog dang*/ /rang 'dod nye ring phyogs ris sogs/ /mi dge'i dri mas ma gos par/ /'gro ba kun la phan 'dogs shog /gzhan gyis bstod sogs dga' ba med/ /smad sogs skyon la mi dga' med/ /'bad med btang snyoms snying rje yis/

/chags sdang dri mas ma gos shog /spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje dang*// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi shes rab dang*/ /phyag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs rnams/ /ma lus bdag la rdzogs par shog /klu sgrub snying po'i mkhyen pa dang*/ /sa ra ha yi rtogs pa dang*/ /bir wa pa yi nus mthu rnams/ /ma lus bdag gis thob par shog /sngags rgyud ma lus sbyor ba shes/ /las tshogs mtha' dag tshegs med 'grub/ /man ngag dpag med mnga' bdag byed/ /mkha' 'gro ma lus mnyes byed shog /chos kun gang nas kyang mi 'ongs/ /gang du yang ni mi 'gro la/ / gar yang mi gnas mnyam pa'i don/ /nges rtogs rab brtan gzhan phan shog / zhe 'dod skyon bral gzhan don du/ /bzo dang bstan bcos thams cad dang*/ / snyan dngags la sogs phyogs med mkhas/ /rgol ba kun gyis mi thub shog / rigs dang yon tan longs spyod dang*/ /ma nor tshig don shes rab dang*/ /mthu rtsal spobs pa la sogs pas/ /mthun rkyen tshogs kyis mi 'phongs shog /smon lam gyi le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //deng sang dus ngan chos pa rnams/ /thos pas rang rgyud thul ba nyung*/ / tshig tshogs mkhas kyang don ma rtogs/ /phyir la nga rgyal rtsod pa 'phel/ /sgrub brgyud bla ma rje btsun rnams/ /don gyi rjes su 'brangs te bsgrubs/ /nga rgyal la sogs gtan spangs nas/ /don rtogs lung rigs dgos pa rdzogs/ /tai lo pas ni nā ro la/ /tshig gcig tsam yang ma gsungs te/ /lung rigs man ngag dang bcas kun/ /ma lus nā ro'i thugs la rdzogs/ /de phyir kho bo'i lab lob 'di/ khengs skyung la sogs kha spyang dang*/ /'gal 'brel rtsis dang zlos pa'i skyon/ /ma brtags mu cor smras pa yin/ /rang gi gdul byar gang bab la/ / 'dis mi phan pa'i srid pa'i mtha'/ /mi khegs snyam nas bris pa yin/ /lung rigs gdams dang mi mthun pa/ /tshig gcig byung na mgo bo khos/ /sprang ban zhang gis rtogs tshod 'di/ /spar bu thul gyi brag sngon du/

/nye gnas bar pas bskul nas bris/ /phyi mir bstan na sdig pa gsog /bka' dang bstan bcos rnams dang ni/ /bla ma rnams kyi dgongs pa dang*/ /rang gis rtogs tshod gleng ba yin/ / e ma ho/ lhun grub man ngag zab mo rnams/ /thugs la rdzogs nas tshig tu bkod/ /snod ldan slob ma rnams la gnang*/ /bla ma rin chen zhang la 'dud/ /bsod nams grub pa'i 'dzam gling na/ /dad pa gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /tshul khrims mdzes pa'i myu gu skyes/ /byang sems snying rje'i sdong po 'dril/ / rig 'dzin sngags kyi me tog shar/ /rig pa rang gsal gyi 'bras bu smin/ / 'od gsal gcer mthong gi longs spyod mdzad/ /skye med mkha' la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /zhang rin po che la gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyag chen lam gyi man ngag mthar thug ces bya ba/ 'gro ba mtha' yas pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /brtsoXn 'grusaX drag po'i srid las nges 'byung ba/ /grags pa'i ba dan phyogs bcu dog por bzhengs/ /gsuXng gi mdzod rdol thar lam man ngag 'diX/ la dwags ban rgan pad+ma chos rgyal gyis/ /'dzad med chos sbyin 'dab stong rab bzhad pa/ /dge bas rgyal bstan snying po dar ba dang*/ /bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan ma gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /gzhi dbyings gdod ma'i sa la dbugs dbyung shog /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / dge'o/ /par 'di rgyal gyi shrī ne'u steng du bzhugs so// // mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang brtson 'grus grags kyi gsung*/phyag rgya chen po lam zab mthar thug PAGE 84- - - PAGE 83 -- PAGE 52 -
